rules.name: Skybane Halo
rules.description:
Each friendly Skybane Halo counts as a separate friendly Group for the purposes of its Aegis-X special rule. While this feature is deployed to a Dropsite, friendly groups treat the Dropsite as if it were a friendly Ship with Aegis-2 on the same Orbital Layer for the purposes of enemy close action and bomber attacks.
This Feature’s Aegis special rule affects friendly Ships in Orbit in addition to Atmosphere.

rules.name: Shrouding Platform
rules.description:
This Dropsite has a Signature of 0” and cannot gain Spikes.
Friendly Groups within 6” of this Dropsite count as having one fewer Spike when an opponent is determining potential targets and assigning Weapons to targets.

rules.name: Infestation Bastion
rules.description:
When friendly Bulk Landers are launched to this Dropsite, they ignore enemy Battalions on this Dropsite.
After enemy Battalions are deployed to this Dropsite, roll a dice for each of those Battalions. For each result of a 5+, remove one of those Battalions. Only one Infestation Bastion can be used this way for each Battalion and any Battalions already on the Dropsite are ignored.

Friendly Wings that activate within 14” of this Flagship may not move further than 14” away from this Flagship.
This Ship may launch Assets regardless of its order, keeping its Signature of 0” on Silent Running and additional turn on Course Change.

sharedRules.name: Savagery

sharedRules.description: Whenever you capture an enemy Ship or an enemy Ship is destroyed due to the Fire Crippling Effect, gain 2AP.
sharedRules.name: Doomed

sharedRules.description:
If this Ship is on an order that allows it to attack, this Ship may forgo one allowed Weapon use during its activation. If it does, at the end of this Ship's activation, you may place an Oculus token on an enemy Group in line of sight in this Ship's Front Arc. Unused Oculus tokens placed by this Ship persist between rounds and are only removed when this Ship would place another Oculus token or when a Ship with an Oculus token goes on the Silent Running order.
When you assign "Oculus" weapons to a Group that has an Oculus Token and is within Scan range of the attacking Group, you may remove the token. If you do, one of the Group's "Oculus" Weapon Systems' Type becomes Core against that Group for that attack.
sharedRules.name: Oculus Booster

sharedRules.description:
Before or after this Group completes any step in its activation, you may have it siphon energy. If you do, pick one other Group within 3” without the Energy Siphon special rule. That Group loses all Spikes and this Group gains those Spikes.
After siphoning at least one Spike from another Group, increase the Attack of this Group’s Siphoned Oculus Rays by 1 until the end of the round. If this Group has 3 or more Spikes after siphoning, increase the Attack of this Group’s Siphoned Oculus Rays by 2 until the end of the round instead.
When this Group is on the General Quarters or Silent Running Orders, it gains Regenerate-X, where X is the amount of Spikes it removes at the start of its activation.
sharedRules.name: Energy Siphon
